info.name: White Label App — Full API (flow-wise)
info.description:
Every endpoint the Flutter app actually calls, generated from lib/constants/api_const.dart + real call sites.

URL rule: full URL = {{base_url}} + endpoint. `base_url` MUST already contain the `/api/` segment and a trailing slash (FlavorConfig.apiBaseUrl), e.g. https://demo.tenaxcode.com/api/.
Most endpoints are prefixed `user/`; Scratch Card + Trade&Win use `v1/user/`.

Auth: Bearer token from login is auto-attached by ApiService for get/post/put/delete/multipart. Collection-level auth = Bearer {{token}}; requests that must be anonymous override auth to `noauth`.

`_t` query param seen in many requests is only a client-side cache-buster.

item.name: 00 — App Bootstrap (pre-login)
item.description: Splash flow: version/maintenance gate, CRM settings, then per-user feature flags after login.

item.name: 01 — Auth
item.description: Register → send OTP → verify OTP → login. 2FA (Google OTP) login verification and password-reset OTP flow included.

item.name: 02 — Password & Security
item.description: Two reset flows exist: legacy (send-otp/reset-password) and the OTP flow under password/*. Plus in-app password change, Google 2FA management, account deletion.

item.name: 04 — KYC & Compliance
item.description: Flow: kyc status → profile/address update → regulation questionnaire → document upload (per-doc or unified multi-file).

item.name: 06 — Trading
item.description: Instruments load per account → place order → manage TP/SL → close position / pending order → history.

item.name: 07 — Deposit
item.description: Deposit methods list → method detail by slug → manual deposit request with proof (multipart) OR Cregis crypto invoice.

item.name: 08 — Withdrawal
item.description: Methods list → method detail by slug → saved user methods → check balance → send OTP → submit request. Bank/UPI/crypto payload differs by method.

item.name: 11 — IB Portal
item.description: Status → apply → dashboard/stats → clients, sub-IBs, structure → commission groups → approval requests → IB internal transfer.

item.name: 13 — Copy Trading (Copier)
item.description: Browse masters → master profile + trade history → eligible accounts → subscribe → manage subscription (pause/resume/stop/add capital/update).

item.name: 15 — Demo Contest
item.description: One endpoint (contests) is reused with query flags for leaderboard / my entries / winners. joinContest bypasses ApiService and hits user/demo-contest/join.

item.name: 16 — Scratch Cards
item.description: Note: these use the v1/user/ prefix, not user/.
